station.rationale: Met Office synoptic climate station with a long, continuous hourly record and 1-hour precipitation. Cranfield (03557399999, ~27 km) is closer but is an aerodrome METAR series; Church Lawford is preferred for climatological precipitation and wind statistics.

thresholds.comment: These are configurable analysis thresholds, not operational safety limits. UI copy must describe them as historical observation frequencies.

precipitation_mm.label: Historical frequency of measurable precipitation
precipitation_mm.description: An observation is counted as a precipitation event when 1-hour precipitation is at least 0.1 mm.

strong_wind_ms.label: Historical frequency of observations above the selected wind threshold
strong_wind_ms.description: Mean wind speed of 5 m/s (~10 kt). Inland Midlands stations are relatively sheltered; this is a breezy threshold, not an operational safety limit.

strong_gust_ms.label: Historical frequency of observations above the selected gust threshold
strong_gust_ms.description: Peak/gust speed of 10 m/s (~19 kt). Not labelled unsafe.

low_visibility_m.label: Historical frequency of observations below the selected visibility threshold
low_visibility_m.description: Visibility under 5 km. Not labelled as a racing-safety judgment.

high_temperature_c.label: Historical frequency of observations above the selected temperature threshold
high_temperature_c.description: Dry-bulb temperature of 25 C or higher.

sessions.comment: Prototype session assumptions, not official FIA sporting regulations.
